question_text: A government agency received a budget of P240,000 divided among 3 departments in the ratio 1:2:3. How much more does the largest share get compared to the smallest?

hint_ladder.title: Think in Parts
hint_ladder.text: Pag ratio 1:2:3, isipin mong hati ang budget sa 1+2+3 = 6 na equal parts. Ilan lahat?

hint_ladder.title: Value per Part
hint_ladder.text: I-divide ang P240,000 sa 6 parts: P40,000 bawat part. Ito ang value ng isang share.

hint_ladder.title: Kunin ang Dalawang Shares
hint_ladder.text: Ang smallest ay 1 part (P40k), largest ay 3 parts (P120k). Multiply lang.

hint_ladder.title: The Final Step
hint_ladder.text: Para malaman 'how much more', i-subtract: P120k – P40k = P80k. O shortcut: 2 parts × P40k.

A.text: You might have chosen A because you found the value per part (P40,000) but forgot the question asked for the difference, not the smallest...

B.text: You might have chosen B because you miscalculated the difference (maybe multiplied 2 parts by wrong per-part value P30,000).

C.text: Correct. The difference is exactly P80,000 (2 parts × P40,000).

D.text: You might have chosen D because you correctly got the largest share (P120,000) but stopped without subtracting the smallest.

next_time_rule: Shortcut: Difference in ratio (3-1=2) times value per part (P40,000) = P80,000. Iwasan kompyutin bawat share.
deconstruct_text:
Kunwari, sa Barangay San Roque, may tatlong proyektong pinaglaanan ng P240,000 mula sa LGU: pag-aayos ng kalsada, pagpapagawa ng daycare, at pagbili ng gamit sa health center. Ang budget ay hinati sa ratio na 1:2:3.

Alamin muna natin ang total parts: 1 + 2 + 3 = 6 parts. I-divide ang P240,000 sa 6 parts: bawat part ay P40,000. Ang pinakamaliit (1 part) ay P40,000, ang pinakamalaki (3 parts) ay P120,000.

Tanong: magkano ang lamang ng pinakamalaki sa pinakamaliit? I-subtract: P120,000 - P40,000 = P80,000. O gamitin ang shortcut: difference ng ratio (3-1=2 parts) times P40,000 = P80,000. Yun na!
